content.text: Covering a land of over 6 acres, Kaziranga National Park is said to be the largest orchid park that the Northeast of India is said to have. This park has enhanced the glory of Kaziranga. The orchid park is home to more than 500 varieties of orchids, placed in its wildest state the orchid improves the ambiance of the park with its beauty and fragrance. The largest Orchid park in India is the abode of the highest population of One-horned Rhinoceros.

blocks.text: Things To Do In Kaziranga National Park

content.text: -Explore the wildlife of Kaziranga through Elephant Safari
-Or take the Open Jeep Safari.
-Witness a wide variety of birds that you’ve never seen before
-Treat yourself to the delicious Assamese food and other cuisines at the park

Just a few kilometers from Kaziranga there are many tribal villages where you can pay a visit. These villages showcase the lifestyle, culture, tradition and local food. The locals have kept their art and creation by weaving shawls and carpets with the help of traditional methods. Don’t forget to purchase some souvenirs to take back home.

Have some extra time in hand? Why not take a drive from Kaziranga and visit this beautiful waterfall. The sparkling clean water is sure to refresh you. Refresh yourself in the water. The locals put out stalls and sell snacks here.

The Hathikuli Tea Estate is a world heritage site located on NH37. Initially, this place was often visited by elephants due to which it received its name Hathikuli[ Assamese word], where ‘hathi’ means elephant and ‘kuli’ means frequently. Covering a land of 15 km, the tea estate produces Orthodox Tea, CTC Tea, Organic Green Tea, Black Pepper, and fish spawns.

The river Brahmaputra is home to one of the rare endangered Gangetic Dolphins. The suitable time to take a boat ride in this pristine river is during the afternoon. Due to the government’s efforts, small dolphins are being preserved by the authorities. The sunset and the glazing waterbody are a must-watch.

The travel time from Guwahati to Kaziranga National Prk is around 3 hr 59 min(193.2km)via NH 27. However, if you want to stop for tea-sipping, you can stop at local tea shops in Morigaon,which is almost the mid-way from Guwahati to Kaziranga.
